title: Do these 5 on a work-from-home day. A chair and a doorframe, nothing else.
caption: Work from home workout with no equipment: Air Squat, Doorframe Row, Incline Push-Up, Seated Knee Lift, Hinge and Reach. All five patterns, three rounds, about ten minutes between calls. Save this for your next day at home.

overlays.text: Do these 5 every day this week, on a work-from-home day.
Air Squat. 10 reps. Feet shoulder width, sit your hips back and down, stand tall.
Doorframe Row. 8 reps. Hold the frame, feet close, lean back, pull yourself in.

scenes.footer: Push. Use a chair that does not roll.

overlays.text: Incline Push-Up. 8 reps. Chair against the wall, hands on the seat, lower and press.
Seated Knee Lift. 10 reps. Sit tall on the chair, lift one knee, then the other.

scenes.footer: Hinge. Stand up from the desk and reach.

overlays.text: Hinge and Reach. 10 reps. Soft knees, push your hips back, reach forward, stand tall.

scenes.footer: All five patterns. Nothing is skipped this week.

overlays.text: Three rounds, about ten minutes. You trained between calls.

scenes.footer: Save this for your next day at home.

overlays.text: What time is your first call?
